evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure processes taken to maintain data integrity.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize data integrity, quality metrics, and testing sessions with no velocity/speed language present, placing this at rigour.
evidence.domain_risk: Develop metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and indicators that have correlation to the on time delivery and inventory of our products.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect internal manufacturing decision-making and inventory/delivery metrics at a semiconductor manufacturer, a real but non-regulatory, non-financial-reporting consequence, placing this at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: data architects; manufacturing IT; other functional areas
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: The role collaborates with existing data architects, IS/BI engineers, and DBAs within an established manufacturing IT function, indicating a growing but already-functioning data organization rather than a from-zero build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Conduct and participate in analysis, design, statistical/model algorithm review, code review, and testing sessions.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name precise technical scope (statistical/model algorithm review, SPC, sigma/p-value/anova, data collection forms, UAT) that shows what the role does day to day, though the four-section structure with all-caps headers reads as somewhat formulaic/templated.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Develop metrics, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and indicators that have correlation to the on time delivery and inventory of our products.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on manufacturing/operational metrics (on-time delivery, inventory) and internal customer requirements, an internal-data orientation tied to operations rather than one specific commercial, product, or finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Write, code, test, and analyze data solutions, applications and automation.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: All responsibilities are scoped execution verbs (implement, collect, create, write, code, test, provide communications) responding to defined business/manufacturing needs rather than setting new strategic direction.
evidence.ai_role: Focus on using AI to accelerate projects... Strong initiative to find AI Solutions on resolving issues... Proficient in at least one of Claude Code, Advance Co-Pilot, Gemini
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to actively use AI coding/productivity tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini) to accelerate their own work, the defining signal of ai_user.
evidence.testing_framing: Conduct and participate in analysis, design, statistical/model algorithm review, code review, and testing sessions.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing and data integrity are framed as an owned responsibility with explicit ownership language (conduct, participate, ensure), not just a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure processes taken to maintain data integrity.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data integrity and quality are named as ongoing secondary concerns without regulatory or stakeholder-trust framing dominating the JD, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Create data analytics solutions to address business opportunities and value... Manage and optimize data discovery and cleansing.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD mixes new-solution-creation language (create data analytics solutions, develop metrics) with maintain/optimize language (implement and maintain, manage and optimize) roughly evenly, making this mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Ensure processes taken to maintain data integrity — a secondary data-quality concern, not a dominant compliance risk register.
